svg.text: Feature invariant: I8: a feature is merged only when its changes are in the primary branch by content, also after a squash merge.
Feature invariant: I9: a feature branch moves only by fast-forward to a candidate that passed its gate.
Feature invariant: I10: before each rebase or forced update of a branch, a rescue ref of the old tip exists.
Feature invariant: A feature is ready only with a full gate pass on its current tip over the current primary branch.
Feature invariant: A gate pass goes stale when either judged tip moves (04 F5).
Feature invariant: A feature is stacked on at most 1 older feature.
TaskBranch invariant: I8: a task branch is landed only when its changes are in the feature branch by content.
TaskBranch invariant: I11: every fleet branch in git has a branches row; one without is adopted as an orphan row, never deleted.
TaskBranch invariant: I12: a branch is deleted only when landed, merged or rescued, and no git stash entry names it.
TaskBranch invariant: A task branch is ready only when its task is done (verified).
TaskBranch invariant: Under the land lock, just before the fast-forward, the task is still landing and held by its worker (04 F9).
TaskBranch invariant: A red land after a rebase resets the branch to its tip from before the land (04 F7).
TaskBranch invariant: An escalated task branch is abandoned only by the operator and only after worktree-rescued (connect N4).

Port IntegrationCommands (driving) via ReconcilePassDriver (fleet-runtime) and CommandChannelHandler: one operation per use case; called by the reconcile pass and the command channel (abandon-task-branch).
Port IntegrationQueries (driving): read models WorktreeList (branch side), PullRequestView, TrialMergeResult.
Port IntegrationEventHandlers (driving) via InProcessReconcileConsumer: policies on task-done, task-escalated, assumptions-written, direct-idea-accepted, idea-tasks-landed.
Port GitObserver (driving) via GitPollObserver: primary-branch-moved and check-merged facts read from git each pass (clock initiated), and pull-request-merged from GitHub.
Port FeatureRepository (driven) via SqliteFeatureRepository: load and save Feature with GateRuns and TrialMerges.
Port TaskBranchRepository (driven) via SqliteTaskBranchRepository: load and save TaskBranch by name.
Port EventPublisher (driven) via LedgerEventLog: writes the event row in the same ledger transaction.

Port GitGateway (driven) via CliGitGateway (vcs::git, vcs::network, vcs::landing): the only caller of rebase, merge-tree, fast-forward, push and branch delete (define N5); content containment, stash list;
never inside a ledger transaction; network calls bounded (04 F11).
Port GateRunner (driven) via ProjectGateRunner: runs the declared fast gate and full gate of the project on a candidate tip.
Port PullRequestGateway (driven) via GhCliPullRequests: open-pull-request: opens a pull request with pr gh, or pushes and builds the compare URL with pr manual.
Port LandLock (driven) via LedgerLandLock: the land lock (1 h, 5 tries).
Port Clock (driven) via PlatformAwakeClock: due_at of branch rows and gate staleness.
Port RescueRefGateway (driven) via InProcessWorktreeCustody: asks worktree-custody to write and read back a rescue ref of the old tip before each rebase or forced update (I10, A13).
